title: Review findings follow a schema a validator checks and a fresh-context verifier confirms
body:
Why: operator-shared trending triage 2026-11-14: cloudflare/security-audit-skill (findings.json with a schema and validator; confirmed requires a full trace, needs_validation carries no severity; the checker is never the finder) and google/elephant-goldfish-model (fresh-context reviewers; review stops instead of pretending when no fresh context exists). KRN review output is free text and self-assessment is not independent acceptance.
Outcome: a findings schema (confirmed | needs_validation | rejected; confirmed requires file:line evidence and a reproducing command), `krn findings validate <file>` exiting non-zero on a confirmed finding without evidence, and the review procedure in docs/program states that a fresh-context verifier, not the finder, sets confirmed.
Proof: validator tests (valid file passes; confirmed without evidence fails; severity on needs_validation fails). npm run fast PASS.
Scope: src/, docs/program/, test/.
